svg.aria-label: SyncScribe: the browser runs a Tiptap editor on a Yjs document with live cursors, version history and Markdown export. The Next.js web app signs people in with GitHub through Auth.js, runs one access check for every action, and mints a two-minute token for a user, document and role. The browser connects to a self-hosted Hocuspocus sync server over a WebSocket with that token; the server verifies it, re-checks the role in Postgres, drops writes from viewers, and stores Yjs state and versions in Postgres. When access changes, Postgres NOTIFY tells the sync server, which closes the socket.

g.text: Tiptap editor on a Yjs doc
Roles are checked twice: by the web app on every request, and by the sync server on the websocket.
